home.welcome_subtitle: Smart Recipes + Eco Quantification, Make Family Dining Greener
home.workflow_step1_text: Choose an age group first so later assessments use the right nutrition standard.
home.workflow_step2_text: Record today's vegetables, fruits, meat, and eggs in grams.
home.workflow_step3_text: After 3 recipe generations, the app automatically assesses nutrition and recommends tomorrow's meals.
home.workflow_note: If you are not sure where to start, choose a group first, then tap “Start Using Smart Recipes”. The other tools can wait.

home.intake_record_subtitle: Please enter the weight (grams) of various foods you've consumed today
home.intake_scope_note: Assessment is for the account holder. Enter what you personally ate, not the total amount served to the table.
